future_outcomes: All current target dates, target prices, realized returns and savings are null/unobserved.
fx_target: Rise in domestic cost of USD payable; EURUSD and GBPUSD raw quote score equals 1 minus economic-cost-up score, USDJPY raw quote score equals economic-cost-up.
issuance: After both exchange-local Copper and FX daily closes for the same anchor date are known; next-session planning proxy, not executable prices.
joint_target: Domestic landed copper unit cost; price-only exact-date same-anchor Copper plus FX features; 9 classifier and 9 Ridge size artifacts.

landed_basis.compatibility: Replay parity verifies this frozen research basis only. Real company duty, freight, cathode premium, execution FX, inventory and supplier terms require separate validation. Ridge output is domestic landed-unit return, not raw Copper or FX return.
landed_basis.copper_instrument: HG=F rolling futures proxy quoted USD per pound; no spot cathode premium

magnitude: Ridge raw return multiplied by frozen per-cell shrink; contextual scenario estimate, not a target price guarantee.
news: No news features, Jev outputs, keys, or customer data are in this selected bundle.
permission: Reference inference only. FX display does not authorize payment deferral; model outputs do not authorize purchasing.
price_source: Public Yahoo five-year daily futures/indicative FX CSVs, no historical vintage or executable-price proof.
scores: All scores uncalibrated; RBF SVC uses sigmoid(decision_function) as an uncalibrated score.
